name: Checkout page header
description: Semantic banner with page title, progress context, and route actions.
accessibility: Uses banner landmark, one h1, descriptive link name, and logical focus order.
implementation: Reuse the product page-header primitive; do not create a checkout-only navigation system.

name: Order summary
description: Responsive summary of items, price, fulfillment, and masked customer details.
accessibility: Uses headings and lists or table semantics appropriate to content; totals do not rely on visual position alone.
implementation: Pure presentation component with typed props and component-level accessibility tests.

name: Order review form
description: Validated delivery fields, error summary, terms control, and retry-safe submit action.
accessibility: Native labels and controls, programmatic error association, error summary links, described requirements, and no focus loss during validation.
implementation: Use repository-native schema validation and form primitives; keep idempotency key outside editable controls.

name: Order status panel
description: Contextual progress, error, offline, permission, and confirmation message with recovery actions.
accessibility: Uses status or alert semantics intentionally, avoids duplicate announcements, moves focus only when task context changes, and never relies on color alone.
implementation: Reuse the product message-bar/status primitive with an owned live-region policy.
